name: mission-ot-continuity-v1
basis: Explicit synthetic mission requirement; not an official CAGE4 or industry SLA
selection_timing: Specified after pilot diagnostics; no retrospective preregistration claim
unavailable: Initially protected service absent or inactive in a post-transition researcher snapshot
max_run_rounding: floor of actual executed phase length times fraction
violation: Any protected service exceeds its phase run limit in mission A or B
risk_unit: Probability of at least one continuity violation in a complete evaluation episode
missing_evidence: Confirmed observed violation stays true; otherwise incomplete evidence is unknown
degradation: Reported separately; not included in this binary unavailability contract
algorithm_compatibility: Undiscounted event cost, not compatible with existing d*T budget bridge without a separately verified adaptation
